question: Under what condition of practice over time are old age and death destroyed?
premises: Practice is undertaken for one year.
When that practice has been done, a condition holds.
Under that condition, old age and death are destroyed.
inference: When the practice has been carried out for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: The nature of the practice is not specified here.
plain_english: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
